segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מִי שֶׁלָּקָה וְשָׁנָה, בֵּית דִּין מַכְנִיסִין אוֹתוֹ לַכִּיפָּה, וּמַאֲכִילִין אוֹתוֹ שְׂעוֹרִין עַד שֶׁכְּרֵיסוֹ מִתְבַּקַּעַת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who was flogged» for violating a prohibition «and» then «repeated» the violation and was flogged again assumes the status of a forewarned transgressor. The «court places him into the vaulted chamber [lakippa] and feeds him barley» bread «until his belly ruptures» due to the low-quality food, and he dies.

moves.summary: the kippa for a repeat offender

positions.claim: one flogged who repeated is placed in the kippa and fed barley until his belly bursts
